title: Finite type quasi-coherent subalgebras and their inclusion diagram
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\mathcal A$ a sheaf of commutative $\mathcal O_X$-algebras [def-weil-pbc-comm-algebra-sheaf]. Define $\Sigma(\mathcal A)$ to be the inclusion-ordered set of subsheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-algebras $\mathcal B\subseteq\mathcal A$ whose underlying module is quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent] and for which $\mathcal B(U)$ is a finitely generated $\mathcal O_X(U)$-algebra for every affine open $U\subseteq X$. Equivalently these are the subobjects of $\mathcal A$ in the category of algebra sheaves satisfying these two properties. Its diagram sends $\mathcal B$ to that algebra sheaf and $\mathcal B\subseteq\mathcal B'$ to the inclusion map.
